metadata.title: Three Circles in a Unit Disk: Three Solutions to an Extremal Problem
metadata.abstract: We place two disks inside the unit disk so that they touch each other and the unit circle. We then insert a disk of the largest possible radius, requiring it to touch both original disks. We show that the smallest possible sum of the three areas is $11\pi/18$, and find all equality cases. We give three solutions, using Descartes' circle theorem, inversion, and contact-point coordinates. The main difficulty is checking that the third disk is largest among all disks that fit, not only among disks touching the first two.

analysis.progressType: 单位圆盘内三圆的面积极值
analysis.workSummary: 先放置两个彼此相切且均内切单位圆的圆盘，再置入最大的第三圆盘。作者得到面积和下界 11π/18，并描述全部等号情形。
analysis.breakthrough: 给出三种解法，并检查在初始两盘固定时所选第三盘的半径对所有可容圆盘都最大。
analysis.limitations: 结论依赖原两盘的相切与边界相切约束，以及第三盘的最大化规则。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
